about: The art and shop audit's proposed art (roadmap 5.13, docs/app-art.md): app-wide illustration outside the study spaces, APPROVED 27 October 2026 (all batches; made in waves of about 15 images, one Gemini usage window each: the 'wave' on every asset). Generated by hand in the Gemini app, saved into inbox/ as <id>.png, then imported. The prompt sheet is prototypes/app-art/art.html. Kurenai's references are her redesign (24 October 2026), copied into refs/.

styles.colour: STYLE: Match the rendering of the attached style reference (the tall woman in the white coat) exactly — high-quality modern anime illustration, light-novel cover quality, fine clean lineart with thin tapered lines, soft cel shading with gentle gradients, detailed fabric folds, rich but slightly muted colours, natural slender proportions, soft even studio lighting from the front-left. Do NOT draw the woman from the style reference; use her only for the art style.
styles.bg: STYLE: Match the rendering of the attached style reference (painterly anime background art, as in a high-budget TV anime or visual novel): soft painted lighting, clean perspective, gentle depth of field. Do NOT draw the woman from the style reference; use her only for the art style.

rules: Never any text: no letters, no numbers on clocks or rulers, no speech bubbles, no captions, no signatures, no logos. Signs, screens, covers and cards are blank. (All text is a live layer.)
Keep Kurenai identical to her redesign sheet: hair, eyes, ornament, coat and dress.
Sprites, spots and badges sit on flat #00FF00 so the import can key them out.
Save each result into art-source/app/inbox/ with the exact file name shown, as PNG at the highest resolution Gemini offers.

kurenai.name: 紅 (Kurenai)
kurenai.role: The Assistant: calm, perceptive and gently amused. Her redesign of 24 October 2026.
kurenai.look: a Japanese woman in her mid-twenties, calm, perceptive and gently amused; long straight black hair to the waist with a violet underlayer showing at the ends, soft side-swept bangs; one small crimson five-petal flower hair ornament on the right side of her head, with no tassel; rose-crimson eyes; a plain white knee-length lab coat worn open, its lining a muted crimson, sleeves turned back once at the cuffs, no patterns, no badges, no writing; under it a simple black high-collared knee-length dress with a single crimson button at the collar and no slit; black tights; black ankle boots with a low heel; holding a slim plain dark tablet; average height, natural proportions

batches.title: The Assistant in her redesign
batches.why: The Assistant still draws Kurenai's first design (the long patterned coat and heels) while Routines and Mind draw her redesign. One new base pose from the redesign sheet; the import cuts the portrait and the familiar from it.

batches.title: The Assistant's expressions
batches.why: Edits of batch 1: only the face changes. One for each state the Assistant already has (thinking, working, success, error, confirmation); idle is the base.

batches.title: Home's hero, by season
batches.why: Home's hero is the first thing on every open and is a flat gradient. Four seasons, one picked by the date, shown at low opacity behind the greeting.

batches.title: The subject desks
batches.why: CS, Maths, IT and Code desks open on a flat card. A still life each in the subject's hue. Japanese already has its cast and scenes.

batches.title: Focus stage scenes
batches.why: The running Focus stage is the screen looked at the longest. One free scene and five for the shop.

batches.title: Collection spotlights and Shrine halls
batches.why: Each vault's Spotlight is a gradient with the bloom; the Shrine's rank 01 hall is a flat panel. Four spotlight backdrops (free) and three halls (shop).

batches.title: Empty states
batches.why: Every empty page in the walk was a kanji tile and a sentence. Eleven small spots, keyed out like Routines'.

batches.title: Reports' story covers and share finishes
batches.why: The story's four cards are flat colour; the share card has one finish. Four covers (free) and three finishes (shop).

batches.title: Painted banners
batches.why: Shop. The four CSS banners are hidden; bring them back as paintings, with two new ones.

batches.title: Kurenai's outfits
batches.why: Approved 27 October: all six, plus the prestige gala outfit. Edits of batch 1's base; their faces are batch 13.

batches.title: Code's capstone badges
batches.why: A passed capstone shows a tick. Six emblems: the four stage capstones and the two track capstones.

batches.title: The Exam Room and Exam Season
batches.why: The Exam Room is plain on purpose. A backdrop at low opacity, and a header for the season.

batches.title: The outfits' expressions
batches.why: Five faces per outfit (35), edits of each outfit's base: only the face changes. Made over waves 6-8, about 15 a Gemini window.

assets.prompt: Kurenai from the attached character sheet and base pose ({look:kurenai}), drawn as a visual-novel character sprite at exactly the same scale, proportions and rendering as the attached base pose. Pose: standing facing the viewer, body turned very slightly to her left, the slim dark tablet held loosely against her side in her left hand, her right hand raised a little in front of her at waist height, palm half open as if offering help, shoulders relaxed, a calm welcoming expression with a small closed-mouth smile, eyes open looking at the viewer. Same outfit, hair and hair ornament as the sheet, nothing added. Centred, the whole figure visible from the top of the hair to the boots, with a small margin above the head and below the feet; nothing cropped. Background: one flat solid pure green colour (#00FF00), completely even, no floor, no cast shadow, no gradient, no green anywhere on the subject.
assets.where: The Assistant's side panel (full figure), the empty thread, and every portrait crop (the import cuts the portrait and the familiar from it).
